checks: Loaded single-file HTML markup without a server
Decoded and scheduled 12 separate playback assets
Seek updates caption and actor from the selected clip boundary
Resumed playback advances from the seek offset
No HTTP(S) requests during load, play, pause or seek
limitations: Audio clock and scheduling tested; this is not a human listening evaluation.
Physical Android/iOS audio latency was not measured.
Sandbox Chromium policy blocked file:// navigation. The same HTML was tested in memory without a server.
